I · The Bienal

The agenda

One question for 2027 — what are the opportunities and threats in a post-money world — and three blocks where it is already a practical matter. The blocks run across both days: in public at the Summit, in closed session at the Forum.

Block01
Block02
Block03Agentic EconomySoftware agents are beginning to hold balances and make payments. How agentic payments are authorised, recorded and supervised, and who carries the liability.

II · The destination

Why here, why now

1.5trillion USDCrypto transaction volume in Latin America, July 2022 – June 2025.
87.7billion USDThe region’s record month, December 2024.
20,345LawUruguay’s virtual-asset law, in force.

Sources · Chainalysis, The 2025 Geography of Cryptocurrency Report · Law 20,345, Uruguay

01Regulation in forceLaw 20,345 sets Uruguay’s framework for virtual assets. The Central Bank supervises their providers.
02Capital in seasonFamily offices and private capital from Argentina, Brazil and Uruguay spend the southern summer in Punta del Este.
03Stable institutionsPredictable rules, and contracts denominated in US dollars as standard practice.
04The destinationPunta del Este already carries weight in the region’s capital circles. The name pre-sells the room.

The Forum and the Summit sit inside a working museum, not a convention hall.

The Museo de Arte Contemporáneo Atchugarry opened in January 2022 in Manantiales, east of Punta del Este. Founded by the sculptor Pablo Atchugarry and designed by the architect Carlos Ott, it is open to the public year-round with an international exhibition programme.

  • 5,000 m²Two connected buildings
  • 40 haGrounds, with a sculpture park of 70 artists

II · The destination · The venue · Ruta 104, km 4.5, Manantiales

The Dinner and the Party are held in a house that runs all year, not a hall hired for the weekend.

Casa Manantial is a members’ house in Montoya, Punta del Este: offices, meeting rooms and a standing programme of talks and private dinners for founders, investors and operators who live in the city or pass through it. It co-produces the Bienal and holds its private layer.

  • All yearOffices, meeting rooms and a members’ programme
  • 2 nightsThe Dinner on Friday, the Party on Saturday

II · The destination · The house · Montoya, Punta del Este

II · The destination

Two days, five rooms

MACA holds the institutional layer: the Forum and the Summit. Casa Manantial holds the private layer: the Dinner and the Party. Three Branded Villas run alongside, one per lead partner.

III · Partnership

Three main partners, three unique villas

The Master and the two Diamond partners each hold a private villa for the weekend of the Bienal.

/01 · The villaStaffed, private, co-brandedA villa in Punta del Este from Friday to Sunday, co-branded with the partner. Held within the Master and Diamond positions; not sold separately.
/02 · The useThe partner’s own programmeTeam base, client meetings and a side programme with the partner’s own guest list. The partner may sell access to it and keeps the content it produces.
/03 · The scheduleFixed slotsSide programmes run on Friday after the Dinner, on Saturday evening and on Sunday. They do not overlap the Forum or the Summit.

IV · The people

How to take part

In short: capital, regulators and infrastructure at one table in Punta del Este, every two years from March 2027. Three subjects, two days, two venues. Attend, speak, support the edition institutionally or join it as a partner.

If you allocate capital, write the rules or build the infrastructure, your seat is at this table.
